summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window; season (second Friday in April to after deer season, mid-December) already manual. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 12 full-hookup sites, 63 RV sites to 70 ft, showers/flush toilets/water stations/laundry/dump. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs, pull-throughs. Fees left as recorded. Catalog marks no campsite waterfront (only two pavilions).
